anstoss.satire.name: Satire
anstoss.satire.info: Events with a sharp pen: presidents, pundits, mayors.
anstoss.teamNights.name: Team nights
anstoss.teamNights.info: Karaoke, pubs, Christmas parties – with an effect on morale.
anstoss.fanActions.name: Fan actions
anstoss.fanActions.info: Displays, special trains, protest banners – with an effect on the fans.
anstoss.curiosities.name: Curiosities
event.ansHoroscope.title: Line-up by star sign
event.ansHoroscope.text: The president of {0} has hired an astrologer, who strongly advises fielding only Aries and Capricorns – the moon is bad for defenders.
event.ansMicrophone.title: Open microphone
event.ansMicrophone.text: The microphone was still on after the press conference. All of {5} now knows what {4} thinks of the canteen food.
event.ansSausageKit.title: Sausage special kit
event.ansSausageKit.text: A sausage maker offers {2} if the team plays one match in a sausage-themed kit. With mustard stripes.
event.ansMayorSpeech.title: The mayor's speech
event.ansMayorSpeech.text: The mayor of {5} gives a speech before kick-off. After 40 minutes the warm-up is over, and so is the applause.
event.ansTvExpert.title: The TV pundit
event.ansTvExpert.text: A TV pundit explains the offside rule live – wrongly – and calls {4} "tactically clueless".
event.ansGnomes.title: Garden gnomes in the stadium
event.ansGnomes.text: The {5} garden gnome society demands a place of honour in the {6}. 300 gnomes, all wearing scarves.
event.antKaraoke.title: Karaoke night
event.antKaraoke.text: The players' committee wants a karaoke night. The captain has already rehearsed three power ballads.
event.antBowling.title: Bowling night
event.antBowling.text: At bowling the kit man beats the entire starting eleven. Spirits are high anyway.
event.antPubNight.title: Dancing on the table
event.antPubNight.text: The team's pub night ends with {1} dancing on the bar. The photo will be in tomorrow's paper.
event.antCooking.title: Cooking class
event.antCooking.text: Team building at a cooking class: {1} burns the pasta, the defence bravely protects the sauce.
event.antThemePark.title: Theme park trip
event.antThemePark.text: After the defeat the assistant suggests a trip to the theme park. Roller coaster instead of a recovery run.
event.antChristmas.title: Christmas party
event.antChristmas.text: The Christmas party is coming up. The players want a gala with a live band, the treasurer a mulled wine stand.
event.anfChoreo.title: Giant choreography
event.anfChoreo.text: The ultras are planning the biggest display in the history of {0} and ask for a contribution towards 4,000 square metres of fabric.
event.anfBusWelcome.title: Welcome at the bus
event.anfBusWelcome.text: After the win hundreds of fans with flares and songs are waiting for the team bus.
event.anfProtest.title: Protest banner
event.anfProtest.text: After the defeat a banner hangs at the training ground: "{4} out!"
event.anfOpenTraining.title: Open training
event.anfOpenTraining.text: The supporters' club asks whether the next training session can be open to the public. 5,000 visitors and a brass band are expected.
event.anfAnthem.title: New club anthem
event.anfAnthem.text: The fans have voted for a new anthem. It is loud, long and rhymes "{0}" with "cup glory".
event.anfSpecialTrain.title: Special train
event.anfSpecialTrain.text: The fans want a special train to the away game at {3} and ask whether the club will pay half.
event.ancMole.title: Mole in the pitch
event.ancMole.text: Overnight 14 molehills have appeared in the penalty area of the {6}. The groundsman calls it a personal duel.
event.ancBallBoy.title: Ball boy goes viral
event.ancBallBoy.text: A {0} ball boy catches a ball with a diving save. The video has more views than every goal of the season.
event.ancFloodlight.title: Training by candlelight
event.ancFloodlight.text: The floodlights fail during evening training. The players carry on with phone torches – romantic, but not very tactical.
event.ancSeagulls.title: Seagull attack
event.ancSeagulls.text: A gang of seagulls steals the bench's sandwiches at half-time. The stands cheer for the seagulls.
event.ancLuckyShorts.title: The lucky shorts
event.ancLuckyShorts.text: {1} has worn the same training shorts for six weeks. He has been scoring ever since – and nobody wants to sit next to him.
event.ancWrongStadium.title: Wrong turn
event.ancWrongStadium.text: The bus driver heads for the local rival's stadium. With a police escort the team just makes it for kick-off.
